svg.title: Current Code City analysis and publication runtime
svg.desc: A top-to-bottom flow shows Analyze capture in the browser main context, immutable revision and complete tree acquisition in one worker, sequential source reads, parsing and metrics, source-free city transfer, controller validation and staging, and atomic publication. A separate failure box states that failure, cancellation, replacement, or a stale generation produces no partial city.
svg.text: Current runtime — one generation-scoped attempt
1. Capture in main context
Validate repository and all exclusions as one snapshot
2. Select immutable revision
Resolve the default head to a complete commit identity
3. Validate the complete tree
Check identity, kind, uniqueness, and raw ancestry
4. Read sources sequentially
Filter after validation; fetch, decode, normalize, admit
5. Process sequentially
Parse, derive metrics, release source, then build the city
6. Transfer one source-free city
Aligned geometry and inspection facts; no source text
7. Validate and stage in main context
Protocol, geometry, facts, WebGL resources, semantic content
Recheck the current generation at each commit boundary
8. Publish one current city atomically
Canvas, semantic UI, commit, search, interaction, inspector
Presenter and semantic publication commit together
Any failure, cancellation, replacement, or stale generation
Release owned work and roll back candidate/current publication
Current file failures abort the attempt; no partial city is shown
Accepted target, not a current flow: per-file continuation, source and unit
drill-down, recursive hierarchy, and explicit Save/reopen.
